tokens.notes: Maintain hierarchy (Headings, Body, Caption). Support Dynamic Type.
Ensure consistency and avoid style drift.

themeBehavior.core: Neutral background, standard contrast, minimal effects.
themeBehavior.reflective: Soft backgrounds (flat/gentle gradient), calm tone, subtle accent.

navigation.controls: Minimal UI chrome. Exit/Cancel, Next, Back, Finish. No unrelated controls.

screens.name: Experience Type Selection
screens.ui: Nav bar + Tab bar visible. Grid of cards.

screens.name: Transition to Examen
screens.ui: Animate tab bar hide. Fade out grid. Enter Posture screen.

screens.name: Prayerful Posture
screens.ui: Full screen. Theme background. Centered text. Begin button.

screens.name: Examen Prompt Step
screens.ui: Full screen Theme background. Prompt card. Nav controls.

screens.name: Completion / Exit
screens.ui: Summary/Confirmation. Return Home button. Tab bar slides in.

requirements.state: Centralized state (Step, InExamen, TabBarVisible). Cleanup on exit.
requirements.performance: Efficient rendering. Fallback for low-end devices.

qaChecklist: Entry: Tab bar hides, correct screen loads
Exit: Tab bar returns, UI stable
